timing: Frozen after known-source input and plant gate inspection, before nine source-section outcomes
extraction: Source RuneTextFile.index_no_newline, take first 970 symbols including punctuation/whitespace, then remove index29. This is before key operations. Exact source files agree with site rune streams in full, but source spacing is used for the 970-symbol cutoff.
generator: For key length k in 3..18, step s in 1..k-1, source shift_pattern emits rows (i*s mod k..k-1, then 0..i*s mod k-1), every i; offsets 0..k-1 advance that iterator first. This generator assigns every ciphertext rune to a key column.
source_gate: For each (k,s,offset), mean normalized 29xIoC over k groups strictly between 1.6 and 2.1. For passing models, infer per-column subtraction shift 0..28 minimizing source baseline-frequency squared distance; mean best distance strictly <0.1 triggers printed output.

scope.output: all source-reported cases, full inferred key and decoded prefix, no post hoc English acceptance rule

source_repair: Replace the integer argument to GuessPattern.groups by GuessPattern.shift_pattern(k,step), matching source zip and all other calls. The original code is not an executed negative.

selection_controls.rule: Within each of the nine extracted source rune prefixes, shuffle rune order independently once per replicate; run the complete 17,424-setting IoC+similarity selection. Preserve per-section outputs and global best source similarity for each replicate. This keeps nine section lengths and rune multisets, but is not a cipher model.

gate: Control plan plant recovered 970/970 and sole source report across 1936 settings; original exception and all1936 schedule/group/zip source operations verified. If target pass is too permissive under shuffled controls, no LP2 solution/negative claim.
limits: Source nine sections use source punctuation to truncate at970 symbols before removing non-runes; canonical site rune arrays agree in full but transcription labels/punctuation are not asserted identical. No other generators, key lengths, interruptions or source unreachable branch tested. Source-derived outputs are candidate shifts, not verified plaintext.
